news.title: Chloe Kelly and Ella Toone dropped by England after not hitting ‘expected’ level
news.lede: Chelsea’s Lexi Potter gets first call-up to face Greece. Leah Williamson back after injury for World Cup playoff. Ella Toone and Chloe Kelly have been dropped from England’s squad because of their performance levels by Sarina Wiegman, who has given a first call-up to the 20-year-old Chelsea midfielder Lexi Potter. Toone and Kelly have played key roles in England’s run of three consecutive major tournament finals but Wiegman made clear on Tuesday, when announcing her selection for the Women’s World Cup qualifying playoff against Greece, that she wants to see more from them for their clubs.

news.title: FIFA Accuses UEFA Of ‘Misinformation’ Campaign In Bid For W/Cup Papers
news.lede: FIFA has accused European football’s governing body UEFA of conducting a “misinformation” campaign in its efforts to obtain documents concerning Gianni Infantino’s abandoned plan to sell stakes in parts of the World Cup’s commercial operations. In a response filed in a Florida court, FIFA said UEFA’s attempt to compel the world governing body to release the documents also amounted to an effort to “influence” next year’s FIFA presidential election. FIFA president Gianni Infantino sparked controversy in July after proposing the creation of a commercial subsidiary that would oversee some of the organisation’s biggest events, including the World Cup and Club World Cup. Under the proposal, private investors would have been allowed to acquire stakes in a company established through the FIFA Forward Enterprise (FFE) initiative.

news.title: Anthony Gordon receives apology from World Cup boss over F-bomb ahead of reunion
news.lede: Javier Aguirre has offered Anthony Gordon a personal apology for his X-rated outburst during Mexico's defeat by England at the World Cup. The former Newcastle winger got on the wrong side of the ex-Mexico boss during their intense last-16 clash, which England won 3-2, with Aguirre shouting, 'F*** you' at Gordon. The incident made headlines across the globe, with the former Magpie coming out to say he was not offended by the remark and instead took it as a "compliment." Aguirre was recently named Valencia's new boss and used his unveiling to apologise to Gordon.

news.title: Ex-World Cup finalist showers in pitch black and wears light-blocking glasses to help him sleep after anxiety battle
news.lede: BRAVE ex-PSG and Netherlands right-back Gregory Van Der Wiel once suffered from such bad anxiety that he was experiencing frequent sleepless nights and panic attacks. Now he’s using his experience to help others who are struggling. Van der Wiel had an excellent footballing career, making 130 appearances for Ajax and a further 89 for PSG between 2012-2016 – purchased with the Parisian club’s Qatari investment money alongside the likes of Zlatan Ibrahimovic. He also made 46 international appearances for the Netherlands, including playing all 120 minutes of their World Cup final defeat to Andres Iniesta and Spain.
